# ProjectCard

A case study in the portfolio grid: cover, context line (client, role, year), title, one-line outcome, the proof metric and topic tags.

`AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ProjectCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx

```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="AleemDesignSystem_3de1ed.ProjectCard" title="{{…}}"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A case study card for the portfolio grid. The whole card is one link.
